info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Sub Custodian Agreement API
info.description: This API allows users to modify existing sub custodian agreements within the banking system. By leveraging this endpoint, financial institutions can ensure that their agreements with external agencies are accurately represented and up to date. Typical consumers of this API include compliance officers and operations teams who need to adjust contract terms swiftly in response to regulatory changes or business needs. The PATCH method enables targeted updates to specific fields, providing flexibility and precision in managing contractual relationships.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific Sub Custodian Agreement identified by its unique resource ID. Provide the necessary information in the request body to modify existing agreements accordingly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the sub-custodian agreement details for the specified resource. Ensure that the required fields comply with the expected schema format. Any changes made will be applied to the existing agreement.

200.description: Request processed successfully, and the resource has been updated.
